description: The Mindmap module: nodes, edges, canvas, layouts, minimap, export—not general app settings unless clearly Mindmap-specific.
detection_hint: mindmap, mind map, node, edge, canvas, hierarchy, minimap, zoom, layout tree, radial, export png, mindmap module

injection.system_prompt_fragment: Mindmaps: work like a tree editor. search_mindmaps to find one, outline_mindmap for a cheap nested tree with short node ids + version, read_mindmap for details on a subtree. create_mindmap with nested outline[] OR from_note_id to build a full diagram in one call (auto-layout). edit_mindmap for batched ops: set_label, add (nested nodes[]), delete, move, link, style — structural changes auto-layout. Pass expected_version from outline/read into edit_mindmap. Prefer tools over prose when mutating diagrams.
